description.zh: 专注 Windows、macOS、Linux 桌面应用，覆盖 Wails/Electron、系统集成、安装升级与跨平台诊断。
description.en: Desktop specialist for Windows, macOS, and Linux, covering Wails/Electron, OS integration, packaging, updates, and cross-platform diagnostics.

welcome_message.zh: 告诉我桌面端功能、崩溃或打包问题
welcome_message.en: Share a desktop feature, crash, or packaging problem

description.zh: 处理窗口、托盘、文件和系统集成
description.en: Handle windows, tray, files, and OS integration

prompt.zh: 请设计并实现以下桌面端功能，覆盖三平台差异、权限、生命周期和测试：
prompt.en: Design and implement this desktop feature, covering platform differences, permissions, lifecycle, and tests:

description.zh: 结合日志、事件和进程生命周期定位
description.en: Use logs, events, and process lifecycle evidence

prompt.zh: 请诊断以下桌面端崩溃或消失问题，先区分退出、隐藏、子进程失败与原生崩溃，再给出取证和修复步骤：
prompt.en: Diagnose this desktop crash or disappearance: distinguish exit, hide-to-tray, child failure, and native crash, then provide evidence collection and remediation:

description.zh: 规划签名、升级和发布验证
description.en: Plan signing, upgrades, and release verification

prompt.zh: 请为以下桌面应用规划原生安装包，包含构建、签名、升级、卸载、数据保留和冒烟测试：
prompt.en: Plan native packaging for this desktop app, including build, signing, upgrade, uninstall, data retention, and smoke tests:

zh: 每周一「11:00」检查桌面端依赖和三平台构建状态
每周五「15:00」汇总崩溃、启动失败和升级问题
每次发布前一天「14:00」生成桌面端冒烟测试清单
en: Every Monday at 11:00, check desktop dependencies and builds on all platforms
Every Friday at 15:00, summarize crashes, startup failures, and update issues
At 14:00 the day before each release, generate a desktop smoke checklist
